title: Org-Mol prioritizes two experimental immersion-coolant candidates
summary: A 3D transformer pretrained on molecular structures and fine-tuned for physical-property prediction screened millions of ester candidates. Researchers synthesized and characterized two selected candidates. One did not meet the preferred thermal-conductivity threshold. This is experimental candidate evaluation, not industrial deployment or environmental-safety validation.

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broad deployment are not established by this review.
evidence.ai_role: A pretrained molecular transformer predicts bulk properties to prioritize candidate esters; researchers assess feasibility, synthesize and measure two candidates.

source_review.scope: Primary preprint abstract and version history
